parts.name: Cabinet Frame
parts.Basic_description: The cabinet frame is the main structural body of the cabinet, made of plywood panels forming the sides, back, and top.
parts.Functional_description: It provides structural support and defines the overall shape of the cabinet, holding the base, shelves, and door in place.
parts.Movement_description: It is a fixed, non-moving part that supports all other components.

parts.name: Cabinet Base
parts.Basic_description: The cabinet base is the bottom panel of the cabinet, made of plywood, providing stability and support.
parts.Functional_description: It supports the weight of stored items and maintains the cabinet’s balance on the floor.
parts.Movement_description: It is a stationary part that does not move during normal use.

parts.name: Shelf
parts.Basic_description: The shelf is a flat horizontal panel inside the cabinet, made of plywood.
parts.Functional_description: It provides a surface for organizing and storing items within the cabinet.
parts.Movement_description: It may be adjustable or removable but typically remains stationary during use.

parts.name: Cabinet Door
parts.Basic_description: The cabinet door is a front panel made of MDF, attached to the frame with hinges and equipped with a handle.
parts.Functional_description: It allows access to the cabinet’s interior and protects stored items from dust and view.
parts.Movement_description: It rotates about its hinges to open and close the cabinet.
